notes:
Short-form CRM notes and direct quotes from calls:
- Product: mobile-first social gaming (2D casual lobbies + 1:1 chat)
- User: Gilbert (Head of Product) emphasized: 'we need snappy chat — players expect near-instant replies.'
- Primary requirement: low client-to-response latency (per-message end-to-end). Interested in hosted API for fast time-to-value.
- Moderation: must block hate speech and spam with tunable thresholds; false positives hurt retention. Looking for built-in moderation or lightweight webhook flow to triage.
- Traffic estimate: 150K MAU, peak concurrent chats ~180-250 messages/sec during events; average message length short (10-40 tokens).
- Notes: engineer shorthand, fragments expected. May progress to Dedicated later if usage ramps.
- References: demo video link incoming, will attach session logs (pseudonymized).
use_case_summary: Mobile/social gaming chat. Objective: real-time conversational assistant + automated moderation pipeline to reduce manual spends and speed up onboarding. Low latency at p95 is critical; cost sensitive as monetization TBD.
latency_targets: median < 80ms server-side generation for short replies; p95 < 250ms; cold-cache token latency measured in isolated runs — goal to keep round-trip under 300ms for most flows.
model_preferences: Prefer small, latency-optimized open models (quantized 7B/13B variants). Will accept fallback to smaller ultra-low-latency model for burst events. Prioritize models with deterministic moderation hooks (or separate moderation model).
poc_milestones: 1) Sign mutual NDA / outline POC scope
2) 1-week technical POC using hosted API with synthetic burst traffic
3) Integrate moderation endpoint and evaluate false positive/negative rates on labeled set
4) Review results, optimize batching/caching, finalize pricing expectations
billing_constraints: Cost-sensitive trial; will evaluate per-token economics and uplift for streaming vs non-streaming. Likely start with hosted, move to Dedicated if predictable throughput and discounts needed.
